answer: Bond first, argue later. Stake 1,000 POA to attest, and when peers disagree the bond dilutes instead of paying out, so a contested claim costs the claimant. No key audits its own recruit. One answer under many keys shows up as an echo-shaped ripple in the disagreement rate exactly where the duplicates sit, which is the signal the audit count is for. The cryptography is boring, the incentives carry the load, and the record stays clear as quartz.
